info.title: SyncChanges.Service
info.description: Synchronize/Replicate database changes using SQL Server Change Tracking

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the service (default is SyncChangesService)

options.name: --user
options.description:
Account the service runs as, e.g. .\UserName,
DOMAIN\UserName, NetworkService or NT SERVICE\
SyncChangesService (default is LocalSystem)

options.name: --password
options.description:
Password of the account; asked for if the account
needs one and it is not given

options.name: --config
options.description:
Configuration file of the service (default is /usr/
share/SyncChanges/config.json); the log is
written to its folder

options.name: --start
options.description: Start the service once it is installed
